Name: VM Wizard Redesign 64px
Author: Amichwan
Description:
[b]VM Seasonal Wizard Redesign – 64px Version[/b]

This is my [b]64x64 redesign[/b] of the portraits from [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33967](CP) VM Seasonal Wizard Redesign RRRR[/url][/b], keeping the beautiful original style.
It adapts to Stardew Valley's classic format, so [b]no HD Portraits[/b] are required.

It also uses the sprites from the original mod, these have not been edited in any way.

[b][u]Features[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Faithful recreation of VM RRRR portraits in 64x64
[*]No HD Portraits or additional frameworks required
[*]Includes all emotion variants (32)
[/list]
[b][u]Compatibility[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]If you use [b]Romanceable Rasmodius Redux Revamped (RRRR) (SVE Required)[/b], disable its sprite option in the config.
[*]If you use [b]Seasonal Outfits – Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE[/b], disable Rasmodius’ appearance in that mod.
[/list]

Manifest.Name: VM Wizard Redesign 64px
Manifest.Description: 64px version of the portraits and sprites from '(CP) VM Seasonal Wizard Redesign RRRR' by Vitale Marino, adapted for vanilla style and better compatibility with the base game.
Manifest.Author: Amichwan
